overview.text: Senja - Collect, Manage and Share Testimonials

offerings.text: Create your form, customize it and add your personalized intro video. With Senja you'll collect twice as many testimonials.
The perfect testimonial for every pitch, page and post. With Senja you'll have one place for all your proof, ready for you and your team to share.
The easiest way to collect testimonials and add them to your website. Get started for free.

problems.text: Testimonials are scattered when the owner updates a course sales page; validate whether a live page update creates urgent proof-collection work.
Campaign teams need relevant customer proof repeatedly; validate which upcoming campaign is blocked by finding or collecting testimonials.
Client testimonial collection delays delivery; validate whether the agency controls collection and publishing rather than merely requesting assets.

valueProposition.text: For course owners collecting or finding student proof for a sales-page update, Senja offers testimonial collection, import and centralized reuse; its fit and commercial value still need buyer validation.

acquisitionChannels.title: Direct email

recommendation.text: Owner-led course businesses: Send researched emails to published business addresses, ask about testimonial workflows before offering evaluation, and respect opt-outs. Researched direct outreach can expose the owner's workflow and purchase authority without assuming existing traffic, users or community access. Tradeoff: Manual research limits reach and unsolicited messages may be ignored, but replies can reveal a concrete task sooner than waiting for asset discovery.

steps: Use public course websites to identify owner-operated businesses, verify a relevant public observation and locate a published business contact route; ask about urgency rather than inferring it.

Activity cap: 6 Research eligible owner-led course businesses and send individually relevant business emails where an appropriate public route exists.

Provisional budget 90 min; planned 90 min: preparation 10, research 7/activity, execution 3/activity, responses 20. Zero direct spend. No weekly reset; re-scope further work.
